definitions.explanation: The act of temporarily suspending or postponing something, typically a service, plan, or decision. Very commonly heard in train announcements when service is suspended.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧{見合|みあ}わせ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{全線|ぜんせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見合|みあ}わせて⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the typhoon, service is suspended on all lines.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}できる→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見合|みあ}わせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決定|けってい}した→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧。
examples.english: They decided to suspend the construction until safety can be confirmed.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in the phrase ⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧{見合|みあ}わせ (service suspension), heard frequently in Japanese train station announcements when trains are stopped due to weather, accidents, or other disruptions. The verb form is {見合|みあ}わせる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧{見合|みあ}わせ (service suspension)
- {見合|みあ}わせ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧ (a suspension occurs)
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見合|みあ}わせる (to hold off on ~, to postpone ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧: cancellation — more final; not just a temporary pause
- ⟦{延期|えんき}→延期：01888_enki⟧: postponement — rescheduling to a later date
- ⟦{一時停止|いちじていし}→一時停止：05401_ichijiteishi⟧: temporary stop — more technical
